summary: NDR on c048_nic is discarding 4.87% of packets at NDR eth1 (90,960 packets, threshold 0.1%). Link is healthy but tool capture interface cannot keep up, causing significant detection coverage loss.

findings.root_cause: NDR eth1 is overrun: the tool's 10Gbps capture interface/NIC cannot keep up with the offered traffic rate, causing kernel/NIC discards after packets are delivered to the tool. Link itself shows no errors, so loss is at the tool ingress, not the network path.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR loses ~4.87% of packets/flows, breaking TCP reassembly, flow correlation and full-payload analysis. Results in missed detections, incomplete metadata and degraded threat coverage despite needing both directions and full payload.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic flow-aware across multiple NDR capture interfaces/nodes so no single 10G interface is overrun, eliminating discards while preserving both directions of each flow for the NDR which requires it.
